title.zh: Frank-Egedal 各向异性压强闭合

summary: Compose explicit common-population hot-ion moments with a radial envelope and prescribed pressure/density scales.

identity.relation: Prescribed Frank-Egedal loss-cone hot-ion moments and radial profile to total gyrotropic pressure fields
identity.direction: (poloidal-flux grid, magnetic-field magnitude grid, closure parameters) -> parallel/perpendicular pressure, optional density/electron energy fields and closure state
identity.definition: The radial operator forms r(psi)=max(1-clip((psi-psi_axis)/(psi_edge-psi_axis),0,1),0)^alpha. The source operator either takes caller Legendre degrees or requests loss-cone degrees from the bound spectrum operator, then selects or projects source coefficients. The hot-ion operator integrates moments at b=B/B0 and normalizes parallel pressure and perpendicular pressure to the parallel moment at b=1, while density is normalized to its own b=1 moment. The pressure operator combines p_gd=gas_dynamic_pressure*r, the optional electron term n*electron_temperature, and hot_pressure_scale*r times the respective hot pressure shape. The graph appends the observable closure_state to that pressure mapping. Density and both hot pressure components use the same velocity_lower (legacy alias perp_velocity_lower) defaulting to zero. The common-domain, accessible-orbit support and raw-moment convergence contracts are those of the hot-ion operator. This corrects the previous perpendicular-only cutoff; no author-confirmed paper erratum is asserted.
identity.model: A prescribed finite-mode nonnegative reference-population closure, with gas-dynamic and optional electron pressure. It does not solve kinetic evolution or establish an exact physical Frank-Egedal distribution.
identity.geometry: A caller-aligned two-dimensional [Z,R] grid of flux labels and strictly positive local magnetic-field magnitudes; radial dependence is a clipped function of the supplied flux label only.
identity.coordinates: psi and B must be finite same-shape [Z,R] arrays. The historical source labels psi in Wb, but this graph uses psi only through its normalized radial interval and output shape. psi, psi_axis and psi_edge must share one caller-selected flux coordinate; a bounded Wb/rad connection to current SciRel free-boundary Picard has been tested, not generally certified.
identity.boundary: The source loss-cone endpoint is xi_tp_mid=sqrt(1-1/mirror_ratio) for a finite mirror_ratio greater than one; pitch/velocity integration is finite and the local pitch interval vanishes when B/B0 reaches the mirror ratio. The radial envelope clips beyond the caller's axis and edge flux labels. For b<1, only orbits reaching B0 are supplied; their local pitch lower bound is sqrt(1-b).
assumptions: psi and B describe the same physical grid and flux convention, which is a caller obligation beyond shape checks.
The prescribed source, quadrature and pressure scales are suitable for the intended plasma; matching source numerics is not a proof of physical validity.
electron_temperature is an energy in J (or Pa*m^3), not an unconverted Kelvin temperature; density times this energy gives electron pressure in Pa.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.description: Caller flux-label grid used for the radial envelope and final pressure shape.
inputs.units: same flux coordinate as params.psi_axis/psi_edge; historical label Wb, or Wb/rad when coupled to current SciRel free-boundary Picard
inputs.constraints: Finite two-dimensional values. psi_axis and psi_edge default to its minimum and maximum; their finite difference must have absolute value at least 1e-30. A constant grid therefore needs explicit distinct axis and edge values.

inputs.name: B
inputs.description: Local magnetic-field magnitude at the same samples as psi.
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly positive; B0 is finite and strictly positive. Shape agreement with psi is checked by the terminal assembly.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Caller-owned closure configuration passed to the four active operators; see constraints for nested names and defaults.
inputs.units: mixed; psi_axis/psi_edge same as psi, field T, pressure Pa, density m^-3, electron energy J, angle deg and dimensionless controls
inputs.constraints: A dict is required. Radial keys: psi_axis=min(psi), psi_edge=max(psi), alpha=1 with alpha>=0; reversed edge orientation is permitted. Field/source keys: B0=median(B), mirror_ratio=turning_b if mirror_ratio absent, otherwise mirror_ratio (default 2), requiring >1; vc_over_v0=0.25 nonnegative; velocity_lower=perp_velocity_lower when the legacy alias is supplied, otherwise 0, within [0,1); both names must agree and define one common population; beta_m=zeff/2 if absent, otherwise beta_m (default zeff=1), finite. Explicit nonempty finite legendre_degrees bypasses spectrum evaluation; otherwise legendre_mode_count=6 and legendre_spectrum_grid_points=256 control it. source_coefficients must be finite and match degrees if supplied; otherwise nbi_pitch_angle_deg=45 controls projection. legendre_terms=15 is a legacy count >=2; both backend names 'truncated' (default) and 'hypergeometric' use the corrected regular initial-value evaluator. velocity_nodes=pitch_nodes=24 by default, each int-converted value >=2. Pressure keys: hot_pressure_scale=p0 if absent, otherwise hot_pressure_scale (default p0=1); gas_dynamic_pressure=0; gas_dynamic_density=background_density if absent; hot_density_scale and electron_temperature are optional. Present pressure, density and electron-energy scales must be finite and nonnegative; the latter is J, not K. Some nested numeric conversions and Legendre evaluations can raise their native exceptions. Raw moments refine with quadrature_rtol=1e-7 and max_quadrature_nodes=max(768,2*max(initial counts)); zero-vc/zero-cutoff divergent density, zero normalizers or unresolved refinement fail explicitly.

outputs.name: p_parallel
outputs.description: Gas-dynamic plus optional electron plus hot-ion parallel pressure.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative on successful return; hot term uses hot_parallel_shape normalized at b=1.

outputs.name: p_perp
outputs.description: Gas-dynamic plus optional electron plus hot-ion perpendicular pressure.
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative on successful return; its hot term is normalized to the b=1 parallel moment, so it need not equal p_parallel at b=1.

outputs.name: density
outputs.description: Gas-dynamic radial density plus radial hot-ion density when either density scale is supplied.
outputs.constraints: None when both gas_dynamic_density/background_density and hot_density_scale are absent. The electron pressure is zero when electron_temperature is absent or no density scale is supplied.

outputs.name: electron_temperature
outputs.description: Constant electron thermal-energy field used for the optional electron pressure.
outputs.constraints: None when unconfigured; may be an array even when density is None, in which case the electron pressure remains zero.

outputs.name: closure_state
outputs.description: Inspectable intermediate source and hot-moment state added by the graph, not a convergence certificate.
outputs.units: mixed; normalized fields and mode arrays are dimensionless
outputs.shape: mapping with [N_Z,N_R] normalized_field and radial_shape, [mode] degrees and source_coefficients, scalar xi_tp_mid, degree_source, legendre_backend, legendre_terms, normalization and quadrature, velocity_domain and quadrature_convergence, reference_raw_moments
outputs.dtype: Python dict containing NumPy arrays, strings, numbers and a quadrature dict
outputs.constraints: Initial quadrature counts, effective raw-moment convergence and common velocity domain are inspectable. They do not establish a physical force balance or kinetic equilibrium. Reference raw moments expose the normalization integrals before division.

preconditions: Consistent same-shape psi/B grids and physically interpretable caller pressure scales.
The explicitly defined reference-population raw moments must be integrable and resolved.
supported: Composition of the documented radial, source, spectrum, common-population hot-moment and pressure-assembly operators.
excluded: An exact kinetic solution, self-consistent force balance, measured-plasma validation or an author-confirmed interpretation of the Eq19b conflict.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Dependency-specific validation failures propagate; params must be a dict.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: No graph-local replacement or suppressed numerical failure.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Source normalization, spectrum or raw hot-moment nonconvergence propagates; the graph does not return a partially normalized pressure closure.

example.description: Evaluate a two-by-two prescribed closure with explicit fractional degree and inspect the returned state without invoking the spectrum solver.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import solve_frank_egedal_pressure_closure
psi = np.array([[0.0, 0.5], [0.25, 1.0]])
B = np.array([[1.0, 1.1], [1.2, 1.3]])
r = solve_frank_egedal_pressure_closure({'psi': psi, 'B': B, 'params': {'psi_axis': 0.0, 'psi_edge': 1.0, 'B0': 1.0, 'p0': 8.0, 'mirror_ratio': 2.0, 'legendre_degrees': [0.5], 'source_coefficients': [1.0], 'velocity_nodes': 6, 'pitch_nodes': 6}})
assert set(r) == {'p_parallel', 'p_perp', 'density', 'electron_temperature', 'closure_state'}
assert r['p_parallel'].shape == r['p_perp'].shape == (2, 2)
assert np.all(np.isfinite(r['p_parallel'])) and np.all(np.isfinite(r['p_perp']))
assert r['density'] is None and r['electron_temperature'] is None
assert r['closure_state']['degree_source'] == 'caller_supplied'
assert r['closure_state']['normalization'] == 'pressure moments referenced to hot_parallel(b=1); density referenced to hot_density(b=1)'
example.expected: Observed PASS: Finite two-by-two parallel/perpendicular pressure fields, absent optional density/electron-energy fields and a caller-supplied-degree closure state.

scope: Composition retains the corrected common-population velocity domain and raw-moment convergence state.
The exact-document example exercises the real public composition API.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Direct repository tests establish the numerical relation, output structure, and declared failure behavior for the tested inputs. Evidence is bounded by the documented applicability domain; it does not establish untested physical regimes, human scientific endorsement, or redistribution rights.
known_limitations: A common cutoff changes legacy parallel/density results as well as perpendicular pressure.
This graph does not prove that a finite modal population solves the original physical kinetic equation.
Scientific validity is bounded by the tested numerical domain and applicability conditions.

nodes.description: Evaluate the clipped flux-envelope array; runtime asset_loader uses the underscored identity.
Bind the public spectrum callable for source projection; its numerical invocation occurs only when legendre_degrees is absent.
Select or generate Legendre degrees and source coefficients, retaining source and backend metadata.
Evaluate field-dependent hot moments and normalize them at b=1 using local quadrature.
Apply caller scales and radial profile to hot moments and optional gas/electron contributions.
Add closure_state with the returned source/moment fields and the fixed normalization description; no scientific relation is recalculated.

edges.description: Common output grid and pressure shape.
Radial axis, edge and exponent controls.
edges.transform: Shallow-copy caller mapping once and pass unchanged.

edges.description: Bound public callable for generated fractional degrees.
edges.condition: The binding is always supplied; the source calls it only when legendre_degrees is absent.
edges.transform: Callable binding without evaluating a spectrum for explicit degrees.

edges.description: Mode evaluator selected by the source backend.
edges.transform: Pass bound callable; no new numerical rule.

edges.description: Hot parallel moment profile normalized at b=1.
Hot perpendicular moment profile referenced to parallel b=1.
Hot density moment profile normalized to density at b=1.

edges.condition: On success; the graph defaults a missing source key to 'truncated'.
edges.transform: Read mapping value or default to 'truncated'.

edges.description: Actual velocity and pitch quadrature node counts.

execution.ordering: Copy params; evaluate radial envelope; bind the spectrum callable and project source modes (invoking spectrum only if degrees are not supplied); integrate hot-ion moments at B; assemble pressure/density/electron-energy fields; append closure_state. The dependency edges are acyclic.
branches: Explicit legendre_degrees bypasses numerical spectrum invocation; absent degrees requests modes through the bound loss-cone-spectrum operator.
Caller source_coefficients bypasses NBI-angle projection; otherwise project coefficients with the selected Legendre backend.
Absent density scales return density=None; electron_temperature may still be returned without adding electron pressure.
execution.state_ownership: The caller owns input arrays and params; the graph makes a shallow params copy and owns only intermediate mappings and returned arrays. The hot-moment operator has a per-call b-value cache; no state persists across calls.
execution.failure_propagation: Any leaf validation or numerical exception stops the call and propagates; no partial pressure mapping or fallback model is returned.
